name: OpenCode reusable pipeline

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Issue containing the OpenCode label
        required: true
        type: string
      request:
        description: Exact issue request text
        required: true
        type: string
      issue_title:
        description: Issue title for reporting
        required: true
        type: string
      labels_json:
        description: JSON array of issue label names
        required: false
        default: '[]'
        type: string
      sender:
        description: GitHub username that submitted the request
        required: true
        type: string
      runtime_ref:
        description: Approved central runtime commit matching this reusable workflow
        required: true
        type: string
      target_ref:
        description: Validated result base branch
        required: true
        type: string
      target_sha:
        description: Validated project commit
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY:
        required: false
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON:
        required: false
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY:
        required: false
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
        required: false
jobs:
  opencode:
    # Ubuntu is the default; the mac label opts this run into macOS.
    runs-on: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"mac"') && 'macos-latest' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    # GitHub-hosted jobs are killed (reported as cancelled) at 6h; stop just before that.
    timeout-minutes: 355
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
    env:
      SSH_NAME: opencode-issue-${{ inputs.issue_number }}-${{ github.run_id }}-ssh
      OPENCODE_WEB_PORT: 4096
      PROJECT_PATH: ${{ vars.PROJECT_DIR || './' }}
      PROJECT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ vars.PROJECT_DIR || './' }}
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WORKSPACES: "true"
      OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA: "true"
      OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WEBSOCKETS: "true"
      TARGET_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
      TARGET_REPO: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
      TARGET_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      TARGET_REF: ${{ inputs.target_ref }}
      TARGET_SHA: ${{ inputs.target_sha }}
      RUNTIME_REF: ${{ inputs.runtime_ref }}
      APP_PORT: 3000
      BRANCH_NAME: opencode/${{ github.run_id }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY != '' }}
      TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      OMGITHUB_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com' }}
      COMMENT_BODY: ${{ inputs.request }}
      LABELS_JSON: ${{ inputs.labels_json }}
      TEST_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"test"') && contains(inputs.labels_json, '"OpenCode"') }}
      GOAL_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"Goal"') }}
      RALPH_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"ralph"') }}
      OMO_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"omo"') }}
      SSH_ONLY_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"ssh"') }}
      WARP_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"warp"') }}
      # Settings > Residential proxy fallback (DataImpulse), off by default, adds the proxy label.
      PROXY_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"proxy"') }}
      VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.VALIDATION_ENABLED || 'true' }}
    steps:
      - name: Record job start time
        shell: bash
        run: echo "JOB_STARTED_AT=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Authenticate status callbacks
        shell: bash
        env:
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          OMGITHUB_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com' }}
        run: |
          /usr/bin/time -p node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          const env = process.env;
          const origin = env.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN.replace(/\/$/, '');
          const url = new URL(env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL);
          url.searchParams.set('audience', origin);
          async function json(url, options) {
            const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Callback authentication HTTP ${response.status}`);
            return response.json();
          }
          for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
            try {
              const identity = await json(url, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}` } });
              const { token } = await json(`${origin}/api/github/${env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${env.ISSUE_NUMBER}/callback-token`, {
                method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${identity.value}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ run: env.GITHUB_RUN_ID, attempt: Number(env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT) })
              });
              console.log(`::add-mask::${token}`);
              appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_ENV, `OMGITHUB_CALLBACK_TOKEN=${token}\n`);
              break;
            } catch (error) {
              if (attempt === 2) throw error;
              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000 * 2 ** attempt));
            }
          }
          NODE
      - name: Register Actions progress
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OMGITHUB_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Bootstrap without the runtime checkout; the lifecycle owns later updates.
          /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 20 \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMGITHUB_CALLBACK_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            --data "{\"run\":\"$GITHUB_RUN_ID\",\"attempt\":$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,\"sequence\":1,\"state\":\"starting\"}" \
            "$OMGITHUB_ORIGIN/api/github/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER/run"

      - name: Publish task link
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          issue_url="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          {
            echo '## OpenCode task'
            echo
            echo "[Open triggering issue](${issue_url})"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Export target token
        shell: bash
        run: echo "GH_TOKEN=${{ github.token }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Checkout target repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          ref: ${{ inputs.target_sha }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Set worker paths outside the project
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p printf 'SSH_DIR=%s\nOPENCODE_WEB_DIR=%s\nRUNTIME_DIR=%s\nAGENTSWEB_DIR=%s\n' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-ssh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-web" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-runtime" "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-agentsweb" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Fetch centralized OMG runtime outside the project
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p git init "$RUNTIME_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p git -C "$RUNTIME_DIR" remote add origin https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub.git
          /usr/bin/time -p git -C "$RUNTIME_DIR" fetch --depth=1 origin "$RUNTIME_REF"
          /usr/bin/time -p git -C "$RUNTIME_DIR" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          [[ "$(git -C "$RUNTIME_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)" == "$RUNTIME_REF" ]]

      - name: Load account credentials
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/account-credentials.mjs" load

      - name: Fetch AgentsWeb tunnel client outside the project
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED == 'true'
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p git clone --depth=1 --filter=blob:none --sparse \
            https://github.com/denaidark/agent-workspace.git "$AGENTSWEB_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p git -C "$AGENTSWEB_DIR" sparse-checkout set lolgames_tunnel
          /usr/bin/time -p test -f "$AGENTSWEB_DIR/lolgames_tunnel/client.py"

      - name: Start AgentsWeb SSH session
        id: agentsweb
        timeout-minutes: 5
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED == 'true'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER starts at 1 in every repository, so using it here
          # makes every new repository's first OMG run contend for port 32001.
          # GITHUB_RUN_ID is globally unique and distributes runs across the
          # broker's 32000-32999 public-port range.
          REQUESTED_SSH_PORT=$((32000 + GITHUB_RUN_ID % 1000))
          # Reuse the runner's sshd without touching apt or preview dependencies.
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == 'Linux' && ! -x /usr/sbin/sshd ]]; then
            /usr/bin/time -p timeout --kill-after=10s 90s sudo -n apt-get \
              -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true -o Acquire::Retries=1 \
              -o Acquire::http::Timeout=20 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=20 update
            /usr/bin/time -p timeout --kill-after=10s 90s sudo -n apt-get \
              -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true -o Acquire::Retries=1 \
              -o Acquire::http::Timeout=20 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=20 install -y openssh-server
          fi
          /usr/bin/time -p test -x /usr/sbin/sshd
          install -d -m 700 "$SSH_DIR"
          SSH_KEY="$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519"
          SSH_PUBLIC_KEY="$SSH_KEY.pub"
          printf 'SSH_KEY=%s\nSSH_PUBLIC_KEY=%s\n' "$SSH_KEY" "$SSH_PUBLIC_KEY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f "$SSH_KEY" -N '' -q
          chmod 600 "$SSH_KEY"
          install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
          {
            cat "$SSH_PUBLIC_KEY"
            printf '%s\n' "$AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY"
          } > "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
          chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
          [[ "$RUNNER_OS" != 'Linux' ]] || sudo mkdir -p /run/sshd
          # shellcheck disable=SC2024
          sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -p 2222 \
            -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o PermitRootLogin=no \
            -o PubkeyAuthentication=yes > "$SSH_DIR/sshd.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$SSH_DIR/sshd.pid"
          is_listening() {
            if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == 'macOS' ]]; then
              if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z -w 1 127.0.0.1 2222 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                return 0
              fi
              command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo lsof -nP -a -iTCP:2222 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1
            elif command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              ss -ltn | grep -q ':2222 '
            elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              lsof -nP -a -iTCP:2222 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1
            else
              nc -z 127.0.0.1 2222 >/dev/null 2>&1
            fi
          }
          for _ in {1..120}; do
            if is_listening; then
              break
            fi
            if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$SSH_DIR/sshd.pid")" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo 'Local sshd exited before listening on port 2222.' >&2
              sed -n '1,160p' "$SSH_DIR/sshd.log" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if ! is_listening; then
            echo 'Local sshd did not start listening on port 2222.' >&2
            sed -n '1,160p' "$SSH_DIR/sshd.log" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          nohup env PYTHONPATH="$AGENTSWEB_DIR" \
            python3 -m lolgames_tunnel client 127.0.0.1:2222 \
            --server agentsweb.space --name "$SSH_NAME" --public-port "$REQUESTED_SSH_PORT" \
            > "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.pid"
          for _ in {1..45}; do
            grep -q '^ssh://' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" && break
            if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.pid")" 2>/dev/null; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if ! grep -q '^ssh://' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log"; then
            echo 'AgentsWeb tunnel did not register.' >&2
            sed -n '1,160p' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          SSH_TUNNEL_URL="$(sed -n 's#^\(ssh://[^[:space:]]*\).*#\1#p' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" | head -n 1)"
          endpoint="$(sed -nE 's#^ssh://([^:[:space:]]+):([0-9]+).*$#\1 \2#p' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" | head -n 1)"
          if [[ -z "$endpoint" ]]; then
            echo 'AgentsWeb tunnel registration did not contain a usable SSH endpoint.' >&2
            sed -n '1,160p' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          read -r SSH_HOST SSH_PORT <<<"$endpoint"
          [[ -n "$SSH_HOST" && "$SSH_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p ${SSH_PORT} runner@${SSH_HOST}"
          {
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_HOST=%s\n' "$SSH_HOST"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_PORT=%s\n' "$SSH_PORT"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_COMMAND=%s\n' "$SSH_COMMAND"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_TUNNEL_URL=%s\n' "$SSH_TUNNEL_URL"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          {
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_HOST=%s\n' "$SSH_HOST"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_PORT=%s\n' "$SSH_PORT"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_COMMAND=%s\n' "$SSH_COMMAND"
            printf 'AGENTSWEB_TUNNEL_URL=%s\n' "$SSH_TUNNEL_URL"
          } > "$SSH_DIR/access.env"
          printf 'host=%s\nport=%s\ncommand=%s\n' "$SSH_HOST" "$SSH_PORT" "$SSH_COMMAND" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          ssh_verified=''
          for _ in {1..3}; do
            if ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
              -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 \
              -i "$SSH_KEY" -p "$SSH_PORT" "runner@$SSH_HOST" true; then
              ssh_verified='true'
              break
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          if [[ "$ssh_verified" != 'true' ]]; then
            echo 'AgentsWeb registered, but the SSH endpoint is not reachable.' >&2
            sed -n '1,160p' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$SSH_ONLY_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            body=$'🔐 **SSH-only debugging session is ready.**\n\n'
          else
            body=$'🔐 **Temporary AgentsWeb SSH session is ready.**\n\n'
          fi
          body+="Run: https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"$'\n'
          body+="SSH URL: \`${SSH_TUNNEL_URL}\`"$'\n'
          body+="Host: \`${SSH_HOST}:${SSH_PORT}\`"$'\n\n'
          body+=$'Connect while the job is active:\n\n```sh\n'
          body+="${SSH_COMMAND}"$'\n```\n\n'
          if [[ "$SSH_ONLY_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            body+=$'This run skips OpenCode and holds the runner for five hours for interactive debugging.'
          fi
          comment_response="$(jq -n --arg body "$body" '{body: $body}' \
            | gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/issues/${TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER}/comments" \
              --method POST --input -)"
          comment_id="$(jq -r '.id // empty' <<<"$comment_response")"
          [[ -n "$comment_id" ]]
          printf 'comment_id=%s\n' "$comment_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          /usr/bin/time -p printf '## Worker SSH\n\n```sh\n%s\n```\n' "$SSH_COMMAND" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Prepare selected remix snapshot
        timeout-minutes: 15
        shell: bash
        run: /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/remix-snapshot.mjs"

      - name: Load saved game checkpoint
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/session-checkpoint.mjs" prepare

      - name: Select OpenCode runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          password="$(openssl rand -hex 24)"
          echo "::add-mask::$password"
          printf 'OPENCODE_PASSWORD=%s\nGOAL_REQUEST=false\nRALPH_REQUEST=false\nOMO_REQUEST=false\n' "$password" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Configure Linux Playwright CLI with WebGPU
        # 8 minutes killed run #56: the Azure apt mirror dropped to ~18 kB/s and the
        # mesa/font downloads alone took 13 minutes. Keep a bound, but leave room.
        timeout-minutes: 20
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/setup-linux-playwright.sh"

      - name: Resolve project directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$TEST_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            PROJECT_PATH='workflow-test-project'
          fi
          if [[ "$PROJECT_PATH" = /* || "$PROJECT_PATH" =~ (^|/)\.\.(/|$) ]]; then
            echo "PROJECT_DIR must be a path inside the repository: $PROJECT_PATH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          project_path="${PROJECT_PATH#./}"
          project_path="${project_path%/}"
          project_path="${project_path:-.}"
          if [[ "$project_path" == '.' ]]; then
            resolved_project_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          else
            resolved_project_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$project_path"
          fi
          printf 'PROJECT_PATH=%s\n' "$project_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'PROJECT_DIR=%s\n' "$resolved_project_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Ignore generated project files before OpenCode
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p touch "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore"
          for pattern in 'screenshots/' '*.log' '*.pid' '.agents/' '.agentsweb/' \
            '.omgithub-runtime/' '.opencode-ssh/' '.opencode-web/' 'node_modules/'; do
            if ! /usr/bin/time -p grep -qxF "$pattern" "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore"; then
              /usr/bin/time -p printf '\n%s\n' "$pattern" >> "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore"
            fi
          done

      - name: Checkout shared OpenCode skills
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: denaidark/skills
          path: ${{ env.PROJECT_PATH }}/.agents
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Exclude shared skills from generated changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          project_path="${PROJECT_PATH#./}"
          project_path="${project_path%/}"
          [[ "$project_path" != '.' ]] || project_path=''
          skills_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/.agents/"
          ralph_state_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/.opencode/ralph-loop.local.md"
          screenshots_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/screenshots/"
          grep -qxF "$skills_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$skills_path" >> .git/info/exclude
          grep -qxF "$ralph_state_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$ralph_state_path" >> .git/info/exclude
          grep -qxF "$screenshots_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$screenshots_path" >> .git/info/exclude
          for pattern in '*.log' '*.pid'; do
            grep -qxF "$pattern" .git/info/exclude || echo "$pattern" >> .git/info/exclude
          done
          for relative_runtime_path in '.agentsweb/' '.omgithub-runtime/' '.opencode/goals/' \
            '.opencode-ssh/' '.opencode-web/' 'opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519' \
            'opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519.pub'; do
            runtime_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/$relative_runtime_path"
            grep -qxF "$runtime_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$runtime_path" >> .git/info/exclude
          done

      - name: Install worker instructions
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -d "$PROJECT_DIR"
          template_dir="$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/templates"
          base_template="$template_dir/agents.template.md"
          echo "Loading worker templates from $template_dir for labels: $LABELS_JSON"
          [[ -f "$base_template" ]] || { echo "Missing worker base template: $base_template" >&2; exit 1; }
          cp "$base_template" "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"

          append_template() {
            local template="$1"
            [[ -f "$template" ]] || { echo "Missing worker label template: $template" >&2; exit 1; }
            printf '\n' >> "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
            cat "$template" >> "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
          }

          # Match issue labels and request hashtags to template stems generically.
          template_keys="$(node -e '
            const labels = JSON.parse(process.env.LABELS_JSON || "[]");
            const tags = [...(process.env.COMMENT_BODY || "").matchAll(/(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])#([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/g)].map(match => match[1]);
            const keys = [...labels, ...tags].map(key => key.trim().toLowerCase());
            const platform = keys.includes("mac") ? "mac" : "linux";
            process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify([...keys.filter(key => key !== "mac" && key !== "linux"), platform]));
          ')"
          while IFS= read -r template; do
            template_name="${template##*/}"
            template_stem="${template_name%.md}"
            if jq -e --arg name "$template_stem" \
              'any(.[]; ((ascii_downcase | gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; "")) == ($name | ascii_downcase)))' \
              <<< "$template_keys" >/dev/null; then
              append_template "$template"
            fi
          done < <(find "$template_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' ! -name 'agents.template.md' -print | sort)

      - name: Mark issue in progress
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          GOAL_REQUEST: ${{ env.GOAL_REQUEST }}
          RALPH_REQUEST: ${{ env.RALPH_REQUEST }}
        with:
          retries: 3
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/github-rate-observer.cjs`).attach(github, process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR);
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const statuses = ['in progress', 'validating', 'complete', 'failed'];
            for (const status of statuses) {
              try {
                await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
                  owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                  issue_number: number, name: status
                });
              } catch (error) {
                if (error.status !== 404) throw error;
              }
            }
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              labels: [
                'in progress',
                ...(process.env.GOAL_REQUEST === 'true' ? ['Goal'] : []),
                ...(process.env.RALPH_REQUEST === 'true' ? ['ralph'] : [])
              ]
            });

      - name: Install preview process manager
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/setup-preview-runtime.sh"

      - name: Post SSH-only access details
        id: ssh_access_comment
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST == 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED: ${{ env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/github-rate-observer.cjs`).attach(github, process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR);
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const run = `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              '❌ **SSH-only debugging session could not start.**', '',
              `Run: ${run}`, 'The `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY` secret is not configured.'
            ].join('\n');
            const comment = await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, body
            });
            core.setOutput('comment_id', comment.data.id);
            if (process.env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED !== 'true') core.setFailed('AGENTSWEB SSH is required for the ssh label.');

      - name: Hold SSH-only debugging session
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST == 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED == 'true' && steps.agentsweb.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tunnel_pid="$(<"$SSH_DIR/tunnel.pid")"
          for _ in {1..18000}; do
            if ! kill -0 "$tunnel_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo 'AgentsWeb tunnel exited during the SSH-only hold.' >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Report SSH-only startup failure
        id: ssh_failure_comment
        if: always() && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST == 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED == 'true' && steps.agentsweb.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/github-rate-observer.cjs`).attach(github, process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR);
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const run = `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const comment = await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              body: [
                '❌ **SSH-only debugging session could not start.**', '',
                `Run: ${run}`,
                'AgentsWeb registration or the SSH connectivity check failed. See the workflow logs for the tunnel output.'
              ].join('\n')
            });
            core.setOutput('comment_id', comment.data.id);
            core.setFailed('AgentsWeb registration or SSH connectivity check failed.');

      - name: Configure Mac runner DNS
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/setup-mac-dns.sh"

      - name: Configure Mac Playwright CLI with Metal
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/setup-mac-playwright.sh"

      - name: Start OpenCode web UI and Cloudflare tunnel
        id: opencode_web
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -d -m 700 "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
          # Exact runner commit for this run; build-stats reports it so the project can show it.
          printf '%s\n' "$RUNTIME_REF" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/runtime-ref.txt"
          # Pinned: the image-history plugin targets the v2.2.5 plugin API (session.context, shell.create.before).
          OPENCODE_VERSION="${OPENCODE_PINNED_VERSION:-2.2.5}"
          [[ "$OPENCODE_VERSION" =~ ^2\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://opencode.ai/v2/install -o "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/install-v2.sh"
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/install-v2.sh" --version "$OPENCODE_VERSION" --no-modify-path

          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          [[ -x "$OPENCODE_BIN" ]]
          # The installer runs in a child shell; publish PATH for Actions and fresh SSH shells.
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"
          printf '%s\n' "$HOME/.opencode/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          /usr/bin/time -p sudo -n ln -sfn "$OPENCODE_BIN" /usr/local/bin/opencode
          actual_version="$(/usr/bin/time -p "$OPENCODE_BIN" --version)"
          [[ "$actual_version" == "opencode v$OPENCODE_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'Resolved latest stable OpenCode: %s\n' "$actual_version"
          /usr/bin/time -p opencode --version
          /usr/bin/time -p env PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /bin/bash -c 'command -v opencode; opencode --version'
          install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.config/opencode"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" <<'EOF'
          {
            "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
            "plugin": [],
            "media": {
              "image": {
                "max_width": 1024,
                "max_height": 1024,
                "max_base64_bytes": 150000
              }
            },
            "permission": {
              "*": "allow",
              "task": "allow"
            }
          }
          EOF

          config_tmp="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode.json"
          /usr/bin/time -p jq '.plugin = []' "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"

          /usr/bin/time -p mv "$config_tmp" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
          # Keep only the newest 2 images in model context; strip proxy env from bash-tool children.
          image_history_plugin="$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/opencode-plugins/image-history"
          [[ -f "$image_history_plugin/server.js" ]]
          /usr/bin/time -p jq --arg plugin "$image_history_plugin" \
            '.plugins = (((.plugins // []) + [$plugin]) | unique)' \
            "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
          /usr/bin/time -p mv "$config_tmp" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
          if [[ -n "${FUSION_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            plugin_repo='https://github.com/denaidark/opencode-copilot-fusion.git'
            plugin_commit='8275beda04bbfaa395c073a6b83f89c93801bca2'
            if [[ "$plugin_commit" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]; then
              printf 'FUSION_PLUGIN_COMMIT=%s\n' "$plugin_commit" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
              printf '%s\n' "$plugin_commit" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/fusion-plugin-commit.txt"
              printf '[fusion-plugin] commit=%s\n' "$plugin_commit" >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-run.log"
              /usr/bin/time -p jq --arg plugin "git+$plugin_repo#$plugin_commit" \
                '.plugins = (((.plugins // []) + [$plugin]) | unique) | .small_model = "copilot-fusion-direct/fusion" | .agents.title.model = "copilot-fusion-direct/fusion" | .agents.compaction.model = "copilot-fusion-direct/fusion"' \
                "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
              /usr/bin/time -p mv "$config_tmp" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
              echo "Installed reviewed Copilot Fusion plugin commit $plugin_commit."
            else
              printf 'FUSION_PLUGIN_COMMIT=unavailable\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
              echo 'Invalid reviewed Copilot Fusion commit; keeping the free model chain.' >&2
            fi
          fi
          # Install the reviewed foreground compaction/chunking policy after Fusion.
          fusion_policy="$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/opencode-plugins/fusion-policy"
          [[ -f "$fusion_policy/index.mjs" ]]
          /usr/bin/time -p jq --arg plugin "$fusion_policy" \
            '.plugins = ((.plugins // []) + [$plugin]) | .experimental.background_compaction = false' \
            "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
          /usr/bin/time -p mv "$config_tmp" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
          PORTS="$(node --input-type=module -e '
            import net from "node:net";
            const ports = [];
            for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) {
              const server = net.createServer();
              await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                server.once("error", reject);
                server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve);
              });
              ports.push(server.address().port);
              server.close();
            }
            console.log(ports.join(" "));
          ')"
          read -r OPENCODE_WEB_PORT PROJECT_FILE_PORT OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT <<< "$PORTS"
          [[ "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$PROJECT_FILE_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          {
            printf 'OPENCODE_WEB_PORT=%s\n' "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT"
            printf 'PROJECT_FILE_PORT=%s\n' "$PROJECT_FILE_PORT"
            printf 'OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT=%s\n' "$OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          # WIP capture skips these controller ports; OpenCode's tools do not inherit all of them.
          printf '%s %s %s\n' "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" "$PROJECT_FILE_PORT" "$OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/controller-ports"
          echo "Allocated OpenCode port: $OPENCODE_WEB_PORT"
          echo "Allocated project file server port: $PROJECT_FILE_PORT"
          DEVICE_PROXY=''
          GENERAL_PROXY=''
          # Phone-first egress (live WS presence). Quiet skip when available:false.
          # models.opencode.ai is NOT on the device allowlist — it uses WARP/DataImpulse/direct
          # via compose-egress-proxy.sh when the phone is also up.
          if bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/device-proxy.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/device-proxy" "$OPENCODE_BIN" "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" \
            && DEVICE_PROXY="$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/device-proxy/proxy-url" 2>/dev/null)" && [[ "$DEVICE_PROXY" == http://127.0.0.1:* ]]; then
            echo "Device relay ready (opencode.ai + openrouter.ai; models.opencode.ai stays off the phone)"
            echo "- Device relay: on (phone for opencode.ai / openrouter.ai; models.opencode.ai uses WARP/DataImpulse/direct)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            DEVICE_PROXY=''
          fi
          # Settings > Enable WARP (on by default) adds the warp label. Default with Fusion
          # (plugin resolved on this run) skips WARP; any picked model or Default without Fusion uses it.
          # Still set up WARP/DataImpulse when the phone is up — models.opencode.ai needs that path.
          fusion_on=false
          [[ "${plugin_commit:-}" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]] && fusion_on=true
          WARP_DECISION="$(node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/warp-decision.mjs" "$WARP_REQUEST" "$fusion_on" "$LABELS_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo off)"
          echo "WARP decision: $WARP_DECISION (requested=$WARP_REQUEST, fusion=$fusion_on)"
          if [[ "$WARP_DECISION" == 'skip' ]]; then
            echo "- WARP: skipped for Default because Fusion runs first (set up lazily before a free model)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "WARP_LAZY=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          if [[ "$WARP_DECISION" == 'on' ]]; then
            # Free models through Cloudflare WARP IPv6.
            # Only `opencode serve` gets the proxy; GitHub stays on the runner IP.
            if GENERAL_PROXY="$(bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/warp-proxy.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/warp" "$OPENCODE_BIN" | tail -n 1)" \
              && [[ "$GENERAL_PROXY" == http://127.0.0.1:* ]]; then
              echo "WARP proxy ready: egress $(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/warp/egress" 2>/dev/null)"
              echo "- WARP: on, egress \`$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/warp/egress" 2>/dev/null)\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              # WARP passed its probe; if a free model still hits FreeUsageLimit mid-build,
              # run-with-model-fallback.mjs switches to DataImpulse once.
              echo "WARP_RUNTIME_SWITCH=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            else
              GENERAL_PROXY=''
              # Fallback: sticky worldwide DataImpulse session via a local relay (credentials
              # are masked and stay inside the relay; proxy URL is only 127.0.0.1).
              # Its stdout carries ::add-mask:: lines, so it is never captured here.
              if [[ "$PROXY_REQUEST" != 'true' ]]; then
                echo "::warning title=WARP unavailable::WARP failed and the residential proxy fallback is off in Settings; OpenCode uses the runner network for non-device hosts."
                echo "- WARP: requested but unavailable; residential proxy fallback off; used the runner network for models.opencode.ai" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              elif bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/dataimpulse-proxy.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dataimpulse" "$OPENCODE_BIN" "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" \
                && GENERAL_PROXY="$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/dataimpulse/proxy-url" 2>/dev/null)" && [[ "$GENERAL_PROXY" == http://127.0.0.1:* ]]; then
                echo "DataImpulse proxy ready"
                echo "- WARP: unavailable; used the DataImpulse proxy (incl. models.opencode.ai)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              else
                GENERAL_PROXY=''
                echo "::warning title=WARP unavailable::WARP and the DataImpulse fallback failed; OpenCode uses the runner network for non-device hosts."
                echo "- WARP: requested but unavailable (DataImpulse $(node -p 'require(process.argv[1]).result' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dataimpulse/status.json" 2>/dev/null || echo error)); used the runner network for models.opencode.ai" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              fi
            fi
          fi
          # Compose final HTTPS_PROXY for opencode serve.
          WARP_PROXY=''
          if [[ -n "$DEVICE_PROXY" ]]; then
            if WARP_PROXY="$(bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/compose-egress-proxy.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/egress-mux" "$DEVICE_PROXY" "$GENERAL_PROXY")" \
              && [[ "$WARP_PROXY" == http://127.0.0.1:* ]]; then
              echo "Egress mux ready (device + ${GENERAL_PROXY:+general}${GENERAL_PROXY:-direct for models})"
            else
              echo "::warning title=Egress mux failed::Falling back to device relay only; models.opencode.ai may fail until WARP/direct path is fixed."
              WARP_PROXY="$DEVICE_PROXY"
            fi
          else
            WARP_PROXY="$GENERAL_PROXY"
          fi
          # Admin build stats: record the WARP outcome, then post it right away (best-effort).
          date +%s%3N > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/build-started-at" 2>/dev/null || true
          WARP_STATUS_SOURCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/warp/status.json" PROXY_STATUS_SOURCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/dataimpulse/status.json" WARP_DECISION="$WARP_DECISION" WARP_READY="$([[ -n "$GENERAL_PROXY" ]] && echo 1)" \
            node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),e=process.env,d={on:"on",skip:"skipped_fusion"}[e.WARP_DECISION]||"off";let s={};try{s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(e.WARP_STATUS_SOURCE,"utf8"))}catch{}
              let p={};try{p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(e.PROXY_STATUS_SOURCE,"utf8"))}catch{}
              const px=["proxy_ok","proxy_429","proxy_error"].includes(p.result)?p.result:"";
              const r=d!=="on"?"not_run":px==="proxy_ok"&&e.WARP_READY?px:e.WARP_READY?"ok":px||(["429_fallback","setup_failed"].includes(s.result)?s.result:"setup_failed");
              fs.writeFileSync(e.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR+"/warp-status.json",JSON.stringify({decision:d,result:r,...(d==="on"?{attempt:s.attempt,egress_prefix:s.egress_prefix,egress_prefix64:s.egress_prefix64,colo:s.colo,...(px?{warp_result:["429_fallback","setup_failed"].includes(s.result)?s.result:"setup_failed"}:{})}:{})}))' 2>/dev/null || true
          timeout 20 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/run-record.mjs" starting >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          # Shared with the runtime DataImpulse switch (scripts/runtime-proxy-switch.sh).
          OPENCODE_BIN="$OPENCODE_BIN" bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/start-opencode-serve.sh" "$WARP_PROXY"
          wait_for_http() {
            local url="$1"
            local attempts="$2"
            local response_code
            for _ in $(seq 1 "$attempts"); do
              response_code="$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 \
                --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true)"
              if [[ "$response_code" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
                return 0
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
            return 1
          }
          wait_for_http_response() {
            local url="$1"
            local attempts="$2"
            local response_code
            for _ in $(seq 1 "$attempts"); do
              response_code="$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 \
                --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true)"
              if [[ "$response_code" =~ ^[1-5][0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
                return 0
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
            return 1
          }
          healthy=false
          for _ in {1..45}; do
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_PASSWORD" "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/api/info" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/info.json" && \
              node -e 'const i=require(process.argv[1]);if(i.version!==process.argv[2])process.exit(1)' "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/info.json" "$OPENCODE_VERSION"; then healthy=true; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          [[ "$healthy" == true ]] || { echo 'OpenCode V2 server did not become healthy' >&2; exit 1; }

          export OPENCODE_WEB_PORT
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/account-credentials.mjs" install-console
          nohup node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/account-credentials.mjs" watch > "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-account-auth-sync.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$RUNNER_TEMP/omgithub-account-auth-sync.pid"

          export PROJECT_FILE_PORT
          /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/start-live-files.sh"
          echo 'Tunnel OpenCode, live source files, and final preview independently'
          FRP_VERSION='0.71.1'
          case "$RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" in
            Linux/X64) FRP_ASSET="linux_amd64" ;;
            Linux/ARM64) FRP_ASSET="linux_arm64" ;;
            macOS/X64) FRP_ASSET="darwin_amd64" ;;
            macOS/ARM64) FRP_ASSET="darwin_arm64" ;;
            *) echo "Unsupported runner platform: $RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --output "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/frp.tgz" \
            "https://github.com/fatedier/frp/releases/download/v${FRP_VERSION}/frp_${FRP_VERSION}_${FRP_ASSET}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/frp.tgz" -C "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" --strip-components=1 "frp_${FRP_VERSION}_${FRP_ASSET}/frpc"
          chmod 755 "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/frpc"
          export OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT OPENCODE_WEB_PORT
          export GH_TOKEN='${{ github.token }}'
          nohup node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/session-lifecycle.mjs" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/lifecycle.log" 2>&1 &
          printf '%s\n' "$!" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/lifecycle.pid"
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/worker-tunnel.mjs" start
          /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT/omgithub/heartbeat"

      - name: Configure Git identity
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name 'opencode[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Create OpenCode branch
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME" "$TARGET_SHA"

      - name: Generate mock OpenCode project
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p install -d "$PROJECT_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p cp -R "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/fixtures/test-project/." "$PROJECT_DIR/"
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/write-build-metadata.mjs" \
            "$PROJECT_DIR/build.json" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER" "$TARGET_REPOSITORY"
          /usr/bin/time -p test -f "$PROJECT_DIR/index.html"
          /usr/bin/time -p test -f "$PROJECT_DIR/package.json"
          /usr/bin/time -p install -d "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p cp "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/fixtures/test-project-start.sh" "$PROJECT_DIR/start.sh"

      - name: Resolve OpenCode model and skill labels
        id: opencode_labels
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/github-rate-observer.cjs`).attach(github, process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR);
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const response = await github.rest.issues.listLabelsOnIssue({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              sort: 'created',
              direction: 'asc',
              per_page: 100
            });
            const names = response.data.map(({ name }) => name);
            const modelLabels = names.filter((name) => name.startsWith('model/'));
            if (modelLabels.length > 1) {
              core.setFailed(`Expected at most one model/* label, found: ${modelLabels.join(', ')}`);
              return;
            }
            // Free OpenCode models get retired (the API then answers "ModelDeprecated" and
            // OpenCode reports "Unexpected server error"). Pick a live default from the catalog.
            const { resolveRunModels } = await import(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/run-with-model-fallback.mjs`);
            const fusionEnabled = /^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(String(process.env.FUSION_PLUGIN_COMMIT || ''));
            let live = null;
            try {
              const catalog = await (await fetch('https://models.opencode.ai/api.json', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) })).json();
              live = Object.entries(catalog.opencode?.models || {})
                .filter(([, row]) => row.status !== 'deprecated' && row.tool_call === true && row.cost?.input === 0 && row.cost?.output === 0)
                .map(([id]) => `opencode/${id}`);
            } catch (error) { core.warning(`OpenCode model catalog unavailable: ${error.message}`); }
            const requireShared = process.env.FUSION_REQUIRE_SHARED === 'true';
            const { model, models } = resolveRunModels({ selected: modelLabels[0]?.slice('model/'.length), live, fusionEnabled, requireShared, forceSharedTest: process.env.FUSION_FORCE_SHARED_TEST === 'true', route: process.env.FUSION_ROUTE });
            if (requireShared) core.info('Shared Fusion checkout overrides inherited model labels; primary cannot fall back to a free provider.');
            const skills = names.filter((name) => name.startsWith('skill/'))
              .map((name) => name.slice('skill/'.length)).sort();
            core.setOutput('model', model);
            core.setOutput('models_json', JSON.stringify(models));
            core.setOutput('variant', ['openai/gpt-6.1-sol', 'openai/gpt-6-astra'].includes(model) ? 'high' : '');
            core.setOutput('skills_json', JSON.stringify(skills));
            core.info(`Resolved model=${model}; fusion=${fusionEnabled}; sequence=${models.join(' → ')}; skills=${skills.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);

      - name: Restore saved OpenCode conversation
        if: env.RESUME_CHECKPOINT_FILE != '' && env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/session-checkpoint.mjs" restore

      - name: Initialize project worker
        if: env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/provision-project.mjs"
          /usr/bin/time -p bash -n startup.sh
          /usr/bin/time -p bash startup.sh

      - name: Publish restored workspace
        if: env.RESUME_SESSION_ID != '' && env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/github-rate-observer.cjs`).attach(github, process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR);
            const { projectLink } = require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/project-link.cjs`);
            const body = projectLink(process.env);
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({ owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER), body });

      - name: Start saved app before OpenCode
        id: resume_app
        if: env.RESUME_SESSION_ID != '' && env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.SSH_ONLY_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ ! -f start.sh ]]; then
            echo 'Saved project has no start.sh. Run verification after the user request.'
            echo 'RESUME_STARTUP_STATUS=missing' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif /usr/bin/time -p bash "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/start-project.sh"; then
            echo 'RESUME_STARTUP_STATUS=ready' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'ready=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'Saved startup failed. Run verification after the user request.'
            echo 'RESUME_STARTUP_STATUS=failed' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Publish restored preview
        if: steps.resume_app.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

## Objective
- Keep the product documentation and roadmap aligned with implemented features, prioritize reliability and data protection, and explain OpenRouter and automated branch creation.

## Requirements
- Work directly on `main`; no branches or PRs for the product changes.
- Preserve existing features, especially the collapsible sidebar; integrate selectively.
- Clarify that OCR and semantic search are not implemented and simulator variations are estimates, not predictions or probabilities.
- Prioritize reliability and data protection before simulator and UX work.
- Exclude checkpoint metadata and deployment artifacts.

## Decisions
- Retain the current simulator, named scenarios, safe backups, and sidebar.
- Correct roadmap claims rather than treating existing tests or basic service-worker caching as proof of full coverage or offline support.
- OpenRouter authenticates model requests; it does not itself create Git branches.

## Work State

### Completed
- Updated `README.md` and `roadmap.js` to align roadmap counts and feature claims with the app, and prioritize reliability and data protection.
- Clarified in the roadmap that OCR, embeddings, semantic search, and complete offline reading remain pending; corrected the test metric to avoid claiming unmeasured coverage.
- Validated with `node --test` and `git diff --check`.
- Committed and pushed directly to `main`: `bef4ece` (`Align roadmap with implemented features and priorities`); working tree was clean afterward.
- Explained the OpenCode workflow trigger and OpenRouter’s API-key role.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Pending PRs could not be checked because `gh pr list` failed without `GH_TOKEN`.
- The precise branch-creation step in the external reusable workflow was not verified; the local workflow delegates to it with write permissions.

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `README.md`: Updated product behavior, roadmap counts, and priorities.
- `roadmap.js`: Updated roadmap statuses, metrics, and development order.
- `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`: OpenCode triggers, reusable workflow delegation, and passed secrets.

## Important Context
- `main` and `origin/main` were at `bef4ece` after the push.
- The workflow uses `denaidark/OhMyGithub` reusable workflows pinned to `b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d`; it passes `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- An earlier test run reported 18 passing tests.
- Simulator shows five synthetic variations using seed offsets `[11, 29, 47, 73, 101]`; they are illustrative estimates, not predictions, probabilities, or confidence intervals.

name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d
    with:
      runtime_ref: b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d
    with:
      runtime_ref: b69cee18134c605988f05c62a6f2873f77814d4d
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

## Objective
- Aclarar cómo funciona OpenRouter y por qué el workflow de OpenCode crea ramas; continuar integrando en `main` las ramas útiles, sin incorporar checkpoints ni artefactos de despliegue.

## Requirements
- Trabajar directamente en `main`; no crear ramas ni PRs para cambios del producto.
- Fusionar ramas de trabajo útiles hacia `main`, conservando funciones existentes como el sidebar plegable.
- Excluir metadatos de checkpoints y artefactos de despliegue.
- Priorizar confiabilidad y protección de datos; mantener claras las limitaciones de OCR, búsqueda semántica y simulaciones.

## Decisions
- OpenRouter proporciona autenticación y acceso a modelos mediante API; no crea ramas de Git.
- El workflow de OpenCode puede crear ramas para ejecutar y guardar cambios con permisos de escritura; la etapa exacta depende del workflow reutilizable.
- No fusionar a ciegas: los checkpoints contienen código faltante o cambios que podrían eliminar funciones existentes, así que hay que revisar e integrar selectivamente.

## Work State
### Completed
- `main` contiene y tiene publicado `bef4ece` (`Align roadmap with implemented features and priorities`); en la última comprobación el árbol estaba limpio.
- Se confirmó que `origin/opencode/42374852214` y `origin/opencode-checkpoints/2` ya están integradas en `main`.
- Se examinó `origin/opencode-checkpoints/3`: agrega validación y manejo de importación PDF, restauración de datos, sanitización HTML y pruebas, pero también elimina respaldo JSON, escenarios nombrados y persistencia confiable; no se fusionó.
- Se comprobó que los cambios de documentación/roadmap de checkpoint 4 ya están en `main`; deployments son artefactos, no cambios de producto.

### Active
- Integrar selectivamente las mejoras útiles de `origin/opencode-checkpoints/3` en `main`, preservando las funciones vigentes y revisando seguridad y persistencia.

### Blocked
- No se pudo consultar la lista de PRs porque `gh pr list` falló sin `GH_TOKEN`.
- No está verificado el paso exacto de creación de ramas del workflow reutilizable `denaidark/OhMyGithub`.

## Next Move
1. Comparar y adaptar de checkpoint 3 las mejoras de importación PDF, validación de datos y sanitización, sin retirar respaldos ni escenarios guardados.
2. Correr las pruebas y revisar el diff; luego confirmar si se desea publicar directamente en `main`.
3. Si hace falta responder con precisión dónde crea ramas el workflow, inspeccionar `opencode-reusable.yml` y sus scripts en el commit fijado.

## Objective
- Integrate useful improvements from `origin/opencode-checkpoints/3` into `main` selectively, without bringing in checkpoint or deployment artifacts or breaking existing functionality.

## Requirements
- Work directly on `main`; do not create product branches or PRs.
- Preserve the collapsible sidebar, JSON backups, named saved scenarios, and reliable persistence.
- Prioritize data protection and clearly communicate OCR, semantic-search, and simulation limitations.

## Decisions
- Review checkpoint changes selectively rather than merging blindly.
- Do not integrate checkpoint 1, which removes most of the product; checkpoints 4 and 5 and deployment artifacts have no pending product improvements.
- Checkpoint 3 includes potential improvements to PDF import, validation, persistence, and sanitization; exclude its workflow and `.omgithub` changes.

2. Adapt only improvements compatible with existing product functionality; preserve backup UI and existing tests.
3. Run tests and inspect the resulting diff; confirm whether to publish directly to `main`.

- `roadmap.js`: Feature status and priorities.

## Objective
- Selectively integrate useful improvements from `origin/opencode-checkpoints/3` into `main` without losing existing functionality or importing checkpoint/deployment artifacts.

## Requirements
- Work directly on `main`; no product branches or PRs.
- Preserve the collapsible sidebar, JSON backups, named saved scenarios, and reliable persistence.
- Prioritize data protection and clearly communicate OCR, semantic-search, and simulation limitations.

## Decisions
- Review checkpoint 3 selectively; do not merge it blindly.
- Exclude checkpoint 1, checkpoint workflow/`.omgithub` changes, and deployment artifacts.
- Checkpoints 2 and `origin/opencode/42374852214` are already integrated; checkpoints 4 and 5 have no pending product improvements.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed `main` and `origin/main` are at `bef4ece`; working tree was clean at the last status check.
- Reviewed checkpoint 3’s new tests and major `game.js` changes.
- Confirmed checkpoint 3 deletes backup, scenario, and simulator core modules/tests; removes backup and storage-status UI; and strips backup/scenario event handling.
- Identified that checkpoint 3’s `persist()` silently ignores storage failures, unlike the existing user-facing warnings and recovery protections.

### Active
- Assess safe-to-adapt checkpoint 3 improvements, especially PDF validation/import, IndexedDB retry handling, sanitization, and persisted-state normalization.
- Check roadmap/documentation changes against actual app behavior and existing product limitations.

### Blocked
- PR listing could not be checked because `gh pr list` failed: `GH_TOKEN` is unavailable.
- The exact step where the reusable OpenCode workflow creates branches remains unverified.

## Next Move
1. Compare candidate changes with existing `backup-core.js`, `scenario-core.js`, `simulator-core.js`, and tests; preserve those features and their UI.
2. Adapt only compatible improvements, retaining storage-failure warnings and data recovery protections.
3. Run the test suite, inspect the final diff, and confirm whether to publish directly to `main`.
4. If needed, inspect `.github/workflows/opencode.yml` and pinned workflow scripts for branch-creation behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Main app logic and checkpoint 3 integration candidate.
- `index.html`: Checkpoint 3 removes backup and storage-status UI here.
- `backup-core.js`: Existing JSON backup behavior to preserve.
- `scenario-core.js`: Existing named-scenario behavior to preserve.
- `simulator-core.js`: Existing simulation implementation to preserve and compare.
- `tests/`: Existing tests and checkpoint 3’s proposed replacements/additions.
- `package.json`: Checkpoint 3 adds the `npm test` command.
- `roadmap.js`: Roadmap changes include potentially inaccurate feature claims.
- `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`: Reusable workflow configuration relevant to the unresolved branch question.
- `README.md`: Documents app behavior and test commands.

## Important Context
- Checkpoint 3 is `origin/opencode-checkpoints/3` at `9d7f731`.
- Its `game.js` diff replaces the simulator implementation and removes saved scenarios; these changes are not safe to adopt wholesale.
- Checkpoint 3’s new persistence tests cover normalization and IndexedDB retries, but its implementation removes the visible warning when local storage fails.
- Existing documentation states OCR and embeddings/semantic search are pending; simulation outputs are illustrative, not predictions, probabilities, or confidence intervals.

23: # Verde — estudio personal del cannabis medicinal
24: 
25: Aplicación web personal, local-first y en español, orientada al estudio del cannabis medicinal en Argentina. Su centro es un simulador de ciclo completo con escenarios ilustrativos, una biblioteca de estudio navegable, un catálogo con fuentes declaradas y herramientas de consulta y costeo. No es una red social, un marketplace ni una plataforma de seguimiento diario.
26: 
27: > **Marco de trabajo:** autocultivo registrado en Argentina, con un supuesto de 9 plantas autoflorecientes en 15 m² (3 × 5 m). Verde es una herramienta educativa: no vende cannabis, no habilita cultivos fuera del marco legal y no reemplaza asesoramiento profesional.
28: 
29: ## Qué incluye
30: 
31: ### Inicio
32: - Índice sencillo tipo libro con accesos a las áreas de estudio y trabajo de Verde.
33: - Búsqueda global con `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` sobre sectores, cepas, cursos, recursos, roadmap y etiquetas.
34: 
35: ### Cepas
36: - Catálogo de 16 perfiles demostrativos de autoflorecientes con THC/CBD, ciclo, efectos, terpenos, linaje y notas de referencia.
37: - Categorías Sativa · Índica · CBD medicinal · Híbrida; búsqueda y filtros locales.
38: - Cada perfil indica su procedencia en los datos incluidos. **No se consulta ni integra ninguna API externa**; las referencias a proveedores no implican permiso para reutilizar sus datos.
39: - Ficha lateral con acceso al oráculo local.
40: 
41: ### Simulador
42: - Flujo: **configurar → SIMULAR → revisar el proceso completo**. No requiere avanzar día por día.
43: - Configuración de cepa, cantidad de plantas, duración, ambiente y estrategia.
44: - Timechart del ciclo con crecimiento, salud, humedad, nutrición y rendimiento relativo; las series se pueden activar y desactivar.
45: - Detalle de actividades del proceso, resultados de costo y rendimiento estimados, y selección entre **5 variaciones sintéticas reproducibles** para comparar el efecto de los supuestos.
46: - Las variaciones son estimaciones ilustrativas del modelo, **no predicciones, probabilidades ni intervalos de confianza**. No representan datos empíricos ni validación agronómica.
47: - El benchmark incluye estrategias comparables y exportación de replay a Markdown y JSON.
48: 
49: > Algunas vistas heredadas (por ejemplo, diario/proceso del cultivo actual) permanecen en la interfaz o el código; no son el foco ni una prioridad de desarrollo.
50: 
51: ### Biblioteca
52: - Incluye **28 recursos de demostración** organizados en 6 diplomaturas; el dataset de muestra no contiene los documentos originales.
53: - Índice curso → módulo → recurso, con metadatos, etiquetas, estado y rutas de referencia; búsqueda, filtros, duplicados, anotaciones y rutas de lectura.
54: - Se pueden aportar PDFs desde el navegador. La extracción de texto a Markdown y el PDF original se guardan localmente en el navegador (PDF de hasta 40 MB); los controles permiten descargar los archivos guardados.
55: - El alta no escribe en las carpetas `pdf/` o `md/` del repositorio. Sus rutas son referencias, no archivos creados por la app.
56: - PDFs escaneados se detectan como probablemente sin texto extraíble. **OCR no está implementado.**
57: - Exportación del índice y de rutas de lectura a Markdown.
58: 
59: ### Roadmap
60: - Roadmap editable dentro de la app con **14 frentes y 222 hitos** (63 hechos, 27 en curso, 66 próximos y 66 de visión), 4 horizontes, métricas de progreso, riesgos y no-prioridades. Versión **v4.4 · noviembre de 2026**.
61: - La prioridad de desarrollo es primero la confiabilidad y la protección de datos; después, el simulador y las mejoras de experiencia.
62: - Incluye análisis de 20 productos, 18 oportunidades y 12 brechas como material de referencia; son notas de producto, no integraciones.
63: - Búsqueda, filtros y exportación completa a Markdown. El progreso de hitos se calcula desde los estados del roadmap.
64: - Las cuentas reflejan el contenido actual del archivo; los hitos son una lista editable, no compromisos ni una estimación de fechas.
65: 
66: ### Oráculo
67: - Respuestas locales basadas en una base de conocimiento y en los recursos indexados.
68: - Citas con diplomatura, módulo, identificador y ruta.
69: - Sugerencias de consulta y panel de fuentes navegable.
70: - Aviso legal explícito en preguntas de normativa.
71: 
72: ### Costos
73: - Escenario editable: plantas, rendimiento, precio de referencia, tarifa eléctrica, horas de luz, días y potencia LED.
74: - Cálculo de costo total, por planta y por gramo, valor de referencia y margen.
75: - Distribución del gasto y proyección de escala con advertencias de encuadre.
76: - Guardado del escenario en el navegador.
77: 
78: ### Proceso
79: - Seis fases con objetivos, tareas, focos de atención y costo estimado.
80: - Checklist legal de Argentina y progreso de tareas.
81: - Enlaces al presupuesto y a la biblioteca.
82: 
83: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
84: 
85: No requiere build ni dependencias:
86: 
87: ```bash
88: python3 -m http.server 3002
89: ```
90: 
91: Abrí `http://localhost:3002/`.
92: 
93: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. La configuración de la app se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`; los PDFs y sus Markdown extraídos se guardan aparte en IndexedDB (`verde-pdf-store-v1`). Desde la interfaz se puede descargar/restaurar un respaldo JSON validado; no incluye los PDFs originales y la restauración reemplaza los datos actuales, por lo que conviene conservar una copia aparte.
94: 
95: ## Pruebas
96: 
97: Ejecutá `node --test` para correr las pruebas de simulación, escenarios y respaldos. Hay cobertura automatizada, pero su porcentaje todavía no está medido.
98: 
99: ## Estructura
100: 
101: ```text
102: index.html      Shell, nueve vistas, índice de inicio, modales y navegación
103: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
104: views.css       Inicio, cepas, diario y simulador
105: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso, roadmap y responsive
106: verde-v3.css    Ajustes visuales de las vistas y componentes recientes
107: game.js         Estado, simulador, ingesta PDF local, IndexedDB, render y eventos
108: library.js      Recursos demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
109: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.4: 14 frentes, 222 hitos, métricas, riesgos y no-prioridades
110: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 16 perfiles autoflorecientes con categoría y fuente
111: sw.js           Caché de assets estáticos para la app web
112: manifest.webmanifest  Metadatos de instalación web
113: assets/         Fotografías locales de demostración
114: pdf/README.md   Convenciones previstas para documentos fuente
115: md/README.md    Convenciones previstas para Markdown derivado
116: ```
117: 
118: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
119: 
120: - El índice de biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar procedencia, duplicados y citas. El repositorio no contiene PDFs originales ni Markdown de cursos; `pdf/` y `md/` documentan la estructura prevista. Los archivos que aporte el usuario se conservan localmente en IndexedDB, no se incorporan al repositorio.
121: - El alta de PDFs extrae texto en el navegador y genera Markdown descargable; el original y el texto extraído se guardan en IndexedDB. La búsqueda semántica no está implementada.
122: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
123: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
124: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
125: 
126: ## Marco legal y límites
127: 
128: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
129: 
130: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
131: 
132: ## Supuestos de esta versión
133: 
134: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
135: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
136: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
137: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
138: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.

23: # Verde — estudio personal del cannabis medicinal
24: 
25: Aplicación web personal, local-first y en español, orientada al estudio del cannabis medicinal en Argentina. Su centro es un simulador de ciclo completo con escenarios ilustrativos, una biblioteca de estudio navegable, un catálogo con fuentes declaradas y herramientas de consulta y costeo. No es una red social, un marketplace ni una plataforma de seguimiento diario.
26: 
27: > **Marco de trabajo:** autocultivo registrado en Argentina, con un supuesto de 9 plantas autoflorecientes en 15 m² (3 × 5 m). Verde es una herramienta educativa: no vende cannabis, no habilita cultivos fuera del marco legal y no reemplaza asesoramiento profesional.
28: 
29: ## Qué incluye
30: 
31: ### Inicio
32: - Índice sencillo tipo libro con accesos a las áreas de estudio y trabajo de Verde.
33: - Búsqueda global con `⌘K` / `Ctrl+K` sobre sectores, cepas, cursos, recursos, roadmap y etiquetas.
34: 
35: ### Cepas
36: - Catálogo de 16 perfiles demostrativos de autoflorecientes con THC/CBD, ciclo, efectos, terpenos, linaje y notas de referencia.
37: - Categorías Sativa · Índica · CBD medicinal · Híbrida; búsqueda y filtros locales.
38: - Cada perfil indica su procedencia en los datos incluidos. **No se consulta ni integra ninguna API externa**; las referencias a proveedores no implican permiso para reutilizar sus datos.
39: - Ficha lateral con acceso al oráculo local.
40: 
41: ### Simulador
42: - Flujo: **configurar → SIMULAR → revisar el proceso completo**. No requiere avanzar día por día.
43: - Configuración de cepa, cantidad de plantas, duración, ambiente y estrategia.
44: - Timechart del ciclo con crecimiento, salud, humedad, nutrición y rendimiento relativo; las series se pueden activar y desactivar.
45: - Detalle de actividades del proceso, resultados de costo y rendimiento estimados, y selección entre **5 variaciones sintéticas reproducibles** para comparar el efecto de los supuestos.
46: - Las variaciones son estimaciones ilustrativas del modelo, **no predicciones, probabilidades ni intervalos de confianza**. No representan datos empíricos ni validación agronómica.
47: - El benchmark incluye estrategias comparables y exportación de replay a Markdown y JSON.
48: 
49: > Algunas vistas heredadas (por ejemplo, diario/proceso del cultivo actual) permanecen en la interfaz o el código; no son el foco ni una prioridad de desarrollo.
50: 
51: ### Biblioteca
52: - Incluye **28 recursos de demostración** organizados en 6 diplomaturas; el dataset de muestra no contiene los documentos originales.
53: - Índice curso → módulo → recurso, con metadatos, etiquetas, estado y rutas de referencia; búsqueda, filtros, duplicados, anotaciones y rutas de lectura.
54: - Se pueden aportar PDFs desde el navegador. La extracción de texto a Markdown y el PDF original se guardan localmente en el navegador (PDF de hasta 40 MB); los controles permiten descargar los archivos guardados.
55: - El alta no escribe en las carpetas `pdf/` o `md/` del repositorio. Sus rutas son referencias, no archivos creados por la app.
56: - PDFs escaneados se detectan como probablemente sin texto extraíble. **OCR no está implementado.**
57: - Exportación del índice y de rutas de lectura a Markdown.
58: 
59: ### Roadmap
60: - Roadmap editable dentro de la app con **14 frentes y 222 hitos** (63 hechos, 27 en curso, 66 próximos y 66 de visión), 4 horizontes, métricas de progreso, riesgos y no-prioridades. Versión **v4.4 · noviembre de 2026**.
61: - La prioridad de desarrollo es primero la confiabilidad y la protección de datos; después, el simulador y las mejoras de experiencia.
62: - Incluye análisis de 20 productos, 18 oportunidades y 12 brechas como material de referencia; son notas de producto, no integraciones.
63: - Búsqueda, filtros y exportación completa a Markdown. El progreso de hitos se calcula desde los estados del roadmap.
64: - Las cuentas reflejan el contenido actual del archivo; los hitos son una lista editable, no compromisos ni una estimación de fechas.
65: 
66: ### Oráculo
67: - Respuestas locales basadas en una base de conocimiento y en los recursos indexados.
68: - Citas con diplomatura, módulo, identificador y ruta.
69: - Sugerencias de consulta y panel de fuentes navegable.
70: - Aviso legal explícito en preguntas de normativa.
71: 
72: ### Costos
73: - Escenario editable: plantas, rendimiento, precio de referencia, tarifa eléctrica, horas de luz, días y potencia LED.
74: - Cálculo de costo total, por planta y por gramo, valor de referencia y margen.
75: - Distribución del gasto y proyección de escala con advertencias de encuadre.
76: - Guardado del escenario en el navegador.
77: 
78: ### Proceso
79: - Seis fases con objetivos, tareas, focos de atención y costo estimado.
80: - Checklist legal de Argentina y progreso de tareas.
81: - Enlaces al presupuesto y a la biblioteca.
82: 
83: ## Cómo ejecutarlo
84: 
85: No requiere build ni dependencias:
86: 
87: ```bash
88: python3 -m http.server 3002
89: ```
90: 
91: Abrí `http://localhost:3002/`.
92: 
93: También puede servirse con cualquier servidor estático. La configuración de la app se guarda en `localStorage` con la clave `verde-app-v2`; los PDFs y sus Markdown extraídos se guardan aparte en IndexedDB (`verde-pdf-store-v1`). Desde la interfaz se puede descargar/restaurar un respaldo JSON validado; no incluye los PDFs originales y la restauración reemplaza los datos actuales, por lo que conviene conservar una copia aparte.
94: 
95: ## Pruebas
96: 
97: Ejecutá `node --test` para correr las pruebas de simulación, escenarios y respaldos. Hay cobertura automatizada, pero su porcentaje todavía no está medido.
98: 
99: ## Estructura
100: 
101: ```text
102: index.html      Shell, nueve vistas, índice de inicio, modales y navegación
103: styles.css      Sistema visual, shell, dashboard y componentes base
104: views.css       Inicio, cepas, diario y simulador
105: panels.css      Biblioteca, oráculo, costos, proceso, roadmap y responsive
106: verde-v3.css    Ajustes visuales de las vistas y componentes recientes
107: game.js         Estado, simulador, ingesta PDF local, IndexedDB, render y eventos
108: library.js      Recursos demo, fases, checks legales y base del oráculo
109: roadmap.js      Roadmap v4.4: 14 frentes, 222 hitos, métricas, riesgos y no-prioridades
110: strains.js      Catálogo demo de 16 perfiles autoflorecientes con categoría y fuente
111: sw.js           Caché de assets estáticos para la app web
112: manifest.webmanifest  Metadatos de instalación web
113: assets/         Fotografías locales de demostración
114: pdf/README.md   Convenciones previstas para documentos fuente
115: md/README.md    Convenciones previstas para Markdown derivado
116: ```
117: 
118: ## Datos, fuentes e imágenes
119: 
120: - El índice de biblioteca y las diplomaturas son un **dataset demo** pensado para mostrar procedencia, duplicados y citas. El repositorio no contiene PDFs originales ni Markdown de cursos; `pdf/` y `md/` documentan la estructura prevista. Los archivos que aporte el usuario se conservan localmente en IndexedDB, no se incorporan al repositorio.
121: - El alta de PDFs extrae texto en el navegador y genera Markdown descargable; el original y el texto extraído se guardan en IndexedDB. La búsqueda semántica no está implementada.
122: - El oráculo es una **heurística local**: no envía documentos a terceros y no es un modelo generativo. Sus respuestas citan recursos del índice.
123: - Las fotografías son imágenes de Unsplash incorporadas como material de demostración. No se copiaron assets, marcas ni interfaces de Leafly, Weedmaps, GrowDiaries u otras apps comerciales; el diseño se inspira en patrones de producto (explorador de cepas, diario, ficha de recurso) sin reproducir su identidad visual.
124: - Los perfiles de cepas son síntesis educativas de referencia. No reemplazan la ficha del banco de semillas.
125: 
126: ## Marco legal y límites
127: 
128: Verde parte de un escenario de autocultivo registrado: hasta 9 plantas y 15 m² en el domicilio declarado, sin fines de lucro. Las condiciones concretas dependen de REPROCANN, la jurisdicción y la normativa vigente en 2026.
129: 
130: La app no constituye asesoramiento legal ni médico. No incluye venta, distribución ni recomendaciones terapéuticas individualizadas. Las proyecciones de valor de cosecha son ejercicios de costeo, no una autorización comercial.
131: 
132: ## Supuestos de esta versión
133: 
134: - Temporada de 75 días y 9 autoflorecientes en 15 m².
135: - Indoor con LED de 240 W, 18 horas de luz y tarifa de $95/kWh.
136: - Rendimiento base de 55 g por planta y precio de referencia de $4.500/g.
137: - Datos persistidos solo en el navegador; no hay backend ni cuentas.
138: - El catálogo y la biblioteca son demostrativos y editables desde la interfaz.
